note: Both sets are heavily redundant, repeating the same two figure annotations (∂P/∂θ(θ=0) = -25.52E+6 watt/rad and θk = 6.302336°) and the doubling relation, and both include the same unsupported graph-read estimates (e.g., -90E+6 at the 'last data point', which the figure shows near -120E+6). Set A binds the values to the NREL 5-MW baseline wind turbine, matching the text, whereas Set B repeatedly misbinds them to 'Blade-Pitch Controller' and 'Rotor-Collective Blade-Pitch' (the x-axis variable), which are not the component owning pitch sensitivity. Set A's main defects are calling θk an 'intercept' and a couple of rough plot estimates; Set B has about six misbound-entity claims on top of the same bad estimate, so A is the more faithful set.
